description: Detect double-booked doctors in the healthcare scheduling data using a self-join. Two appointments of the same doctor overlap when a.start_ts < b.end_ts AND b.start_ts < a.end_ts (half-open intervals: back-to-back appointments do not overlap). Ignore appointments with status = 'cancelled'. Report each overlapping pair exactly once with the lower appointment_id first, and the overlap length in minutes. Output columns: doctor_name (STRING), appointment_id_a (INT64), appointment_id_b (INT64), overlap_minutes (INT64). Sort by doctor_name, appointment_id_a, appointment_id_b.
edge_cases: Appointments 2 and 3 touch at 10:30 but do not overlap
Cancelled appointment 4 lies inside two others and must be ignored
Appointments of different doctors at the same time are not conflicts
An appointment fully contained in another overlaps for its whole duration
common_failure_modes: FM1: Self-join with a.appointment_id != b.appointment_id returns each pair twice; without any id condition each row also matches itself
FM2: Using <= in the overlap condition flags back-to-back appointments as conflicts
FM3: Filtering cancelled status on only one side of the self-join
